blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Embodied agents must reason about 3D space while the video is still arriving, answering questions as soon as they have observed enough of the scene. VLMs that incorporate 3D geometric priors achieve strong spatial reasoning, but they operate offline, i.e . , the full video must be available before they produce an answer. Streaming VLMs process frames causally and decide for themselves when to respond, yet they lack explicit 3D representations. We present SpaTime , a streaming VLM that fuses causal geometry tokens into the language model at every frame, using only the frames observed so far. To supervise when the model answers, we propose a response-time loss that maps per-frame response probabilities to a differentiable expected response time and penalizes the distance from the ground-truth frame.
For evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming adaptations of VSTI-Bench and VSI-Bench. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and reduces the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline.
blocks.zh:
健壮的特工必须说明3D空间的原因,而视频还在到来时,只要他们已经对现场进行了足够的观察,就立即回答问题. 包含3D几何前缀的VLM可以实现强烈的空间推理,但它们的操作是离线的,即,完整视频必须在生成答案之前提供. 将VLMs进程框架因果地流出,自行决定何时应答,然而它们却缺乏明确的三维表达. 将因果几何符号连接到语言模型中, 为了监督模型何时回答,我们提议一个响应时间损失,将每帧响应的概率与不同的预期响应时间相映射,并惩罚与地面真实框架的距离。
为了评价,我们建造了StreamVSTI-Bench和StreamVSI-Bench,对VSTI-Bench和VSI-Bench进行流调。 在StreatVSTI-Bench上,SpaTime达到49.2%的整体精度,相对于最强的流线基线将平均响应-时差减少66%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Spatial reasoning over streaming video is an essential capability for real-world embodied intelligence. Consider a robot navigating a kitchen. When asked “is the mug to your left or your right?”, the robot must judge the mug’s position relative to its own viewpoint, which changes as it moves. When asked “how far is the mug from where you started?”, it must maintain a geometric history across frames. In both cases, the question may arrive midstream, while the scene is only partially observed. The robot must decide not only what to answer, but also when . Answering too early means guessing about parts of the scene it has not yet seen, while answering too late stalls the task at hand. Ideally, the robot should answer as soon as it has observed enough information. Deployable embodied and AR systems therefore need a streaming spatial VLM , i.e . , a VLM that reasons about 3D spatial relationships on a live video stream and decides on its own when to answer (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 流媒体视频的空间推理是真实世界所体现智能的基本能力。 考虑一个机器人导航厨房。 当被问到“是左边的杯子还是右边的杯子? ” 时,机器人必须判断该杯子相对于其自身观点的位置,而后者在移动时会发生变化。 当被问到“你的杯子从何而来?” 时,它必须保持跨框几何历史。 在这两种情况下,问题都可能到达中游,而场景只是部分被观察. 机器人不仅必须决定如何回答,而且必须决定何时回答。 回答太早意味着猜测它尚未看到的部分场景,而回答太迟会拖延手头的任务. 理想的情况是,机器人一旦观察到足够的信息,就应该立即回答. 因此,可部署的内含和AR系统需要流出空间的VLM,即VLM,它能解释实时视频流上的3D空间关系,并自行决定何时回答(图1)。

blocks.en: Recent VLM works mainly study one of these two requirements but not both. Offline VLMs specialized for spatial reasoning, e.g . , VG-LLM ( Zheng et al. 2025a ) and VLM-3R ( Fan et al. 2026 ) , inject 3D geometric priors into the language model and achieve strong performance on spatial benchmarks such as VSI-Bench ( Yang et al. 2025b ) . However, every stage of their pipeline, i.e . , geometry encoding, feature fusion, and generation, operates over the full frame sequence. They therefore cannot answer a question that arrives mid-stream. Streaming VLMs, e.g . , VideoLLM-online ( Chen et al. 2024b ) , Dispider ( Qian et al. 2025 ) , and Streamo ( Xia et al. 2026 ) , take the opposite approach. They process frames causally and emit a state token at each frame, which lets the model decide when to answer. However, they lack any explicit 3D representation and struggle on spatial questions.
blocks.zh: 近期的VLM工作主要研究这两个要求中的一个,但两者不同时进行. 离线VLMs专用于空间推理,如:VG-LLM(郑等2025a)和VLM-3R(范等2026)等,为语言模型注入了3D几何前缀并实现了VSI-Bench等空间基准的强性能(杨等2025b. 然而,其管道的每一个阶段,即几何编码,特征聚变,和生成,都运行在全帧序列上. 因此,他们无法回答一个到达中游的问题。 流取VLMs,如:VideoLLM-online (Chen等 2024b),Dispider (Qian等 2025),和流取(Xia等 2026),采取相反的方法. 它们会因果地处理帧,在每个帧发出一个状态符号,让模型决定何时回答. 然而,它们在空间问题上缺乏明确的三维表述和斗争。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Offline VLMs lack real-time answering capability, and general streaming VLMs lack 3D awareness. SpaTime fuses visual and causal 3D geometry tokens to achieve a Streaming VLM for spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 图1:离线VLMs缺乏实时应答能力,一般流线VLM缺乏3D意识. SpaTime将视觉和因果三维几何符号相接而成,以达到为空间推理而流取的VLM.

blocks.en: The difficulty is that these two requirements pull in opposite directions. Building a coherent 3D representation has meant attending over all input frames at once, as in geometry encoders such as VGGT ( Wang et al. 2025a ) , which is exactly what causal, frame-by-frame inference forbids. StreamVGGT ( Zhuo et al. 2026 ) shows this conflict is resolvable at the representation level, distilling VGGT’s global representations into a causal transformer whose key-value cache encodes geometry at constant cost per frame. The encoder is therefore no longer the obstacle, but two pieces above it are still missing. First, the geometry tokens have to reach the language model without reintroducing a dependence on future frames, whereas existing fusion strategies are designed for the offline setting where the full sequence is available. Second, the model has to be supervised on when to answer, yet the losses used by streaming VLMs penalize all temporal errors alike, regardless of how early or late the response is.
blocks.zh: 困难在于这两项要求的取向相反。 建立连贯的3D代表意味着立即参与所有输入帧,例如VGGT(Wang等人,2025a)等几何编码器,这恰恰是每个帧的推断所禁止的。 流线 (Zhuo等2026)表明这种冲突在代表级别上是可以解决的,将VGGT的全球代表分解成一个因果变相器,其键值缓存以每帧不变的成本编码几何. 因此,编码器不再是障碍,但上面有两块仍然被丢失. 第一,几何符号必须到达语言模型,而不重新引入对未来框架的依赖,而现有的聚变策略则是为了提供完整序列的离线设置而设计的. 第二,模型必须在何时回答时加以监督,然而流出VLM使用的损失对所有时间错误都进行惩罚,无论反应是早还是晚。

Each frame is encoded by a frozen visual encoder and a frozen causal geometry encoder, then (b) a lightweight projector aligns the geometry tokens with the visual tokens, and fused via element-wise addition. In (c), a response time loss ℒ time {\mathcal{L}}_{\text{time}} aligns the predicted response time with the ground truth.

blocks.en: We present SpaTime , a streaming VLM (Fig. 2 ), to address these challenges. For the first, SpaTime runs a frozen StreamVGGT geometry encoder alongside the VLM’s frozen visual encoder and fuses the two at every frame. Following VG-LLM’s ( Zheng et al. 2025a ) fusion strategy, we spatially merge the per-frame geometry tokens, project them through a lightweight MLP, and add them to the visual tokens of the same frame. A LoRA-tuned LLM then reads the fused tokens and predicts a state token at each frame. Because the geometry encoder is causal and the fusion is per-frame, no stage of the pipeline consults a future frame, i.e . , it processes only frames ≤ t \leq t at time t t , and its inference cost per frame stays constant as the stream grows.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍SpaTime,这是一个流传的VLM(图2),以应对这些挑战。 首先,SpaTime在VLM被冷冻的视觉编码器旁边运行了被冷冻的StreamVGGT几何编码器,并在每个帧上将两者相接. 按照VG-LLM的(郑等2025a)聚变策略,我们在空间上合并了每帧几何符号,通过轻量级的MLP投影,并加入到同帧的可视符号上. 一个LORA-tuned LLM然后读取被熔接的符号并预测每个帧的状态符号. 由于几何编码器是因果的而聚变是每帧的,因此管道的任何阶段都不咨询未来的帧,即:它只在时间tt处理帧- t\leq t,随着流的增大,每个帧的推论成本保持不变.

blocks.en: For the second, we propose a response-time loss that makes the response time itself trainable. We read per-frame response probabilities off the vocabulary distribution, aggregate them into a differentiable expected response time via soft argmax, and penalize its deviation from the ground-truth frame. The penalty therefore scales with how far the prediction lands from the correct moment, so responding one frame early costs less than responding ten frames early, a distinction that per-frame cross-entropy and focal losses cannot express.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们提出反应时间损失,使反应时间本身可以训练。 我们从词汇分布中读取了每个框架的响应概率,通过软正弦将其组合成一个不同的预期响应时间,并惩罚它偏离地上真实框架。 因此,惩罚的尺度是预测距离正确时间有多远,因此,对一个框架的早期成本作出响应比对10个框架的早期成本作出响应要少,这种区分是无法表达的。

blocks.en: As no spatial reasoning benchmark supports streaming evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench. These benchmarks are streaming adaptations of the popular spatial reasoning benchmarks of VSTI-Bench ( Fan et al. 2026 ) and VSI-Bench ( Yang et al. 2025b ) (Sec. 5 ). We keep the QA annotations of the original benchmarks and assign each question an arrival time and a ground-truth response time. For evaluation, we consider the standard accuracy performance as well as a measure of responsiveness by Δ ​ t \Delta t , the mean absolute error between predicted and ground-truth response times. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy. Notably, it cuts the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline while achieving 5.1 points higher spatial accuracy.
blocks.zh: 由于没有空间推理基准支持流评估,我们构建了StreamVSTI-Bench和StreamVSI-Bench. 这些基准是对VSTI-Bench(Fan等人,2026年)和VSI-Bench(Yang等人,2025年b)(第5节)的流行空间推理基准进行流派调整。 我们保留原基准的质量保证说明,并为每个问题分配一个到达时间和地面真实答复时间。 对于评价,我们考虑标准准确性表现以及QQ t\Delta t的响应度量,即预测和地面真实响应时间之间的平均绝对错误. 在StreamVSTI-Bench上,SpaTime达到49.2%的总精度. 值得注意的是,相对于最强流线基线,它将平均响应时间误差减少了66%,同时实现了5.1分更高的空间精度.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We introduce SpaTime, a streaming VLM that fuses causal 3D geometry tokens into a language model without consulting future frames, at constant cost per frame. • We propose a response-time loss that supervises when the model answers, penalizing a predicted response time in proportion to its distance from the correct frame. • We develop a streaming conversion pipeline for spatial QA and use it to build two benchmarks, StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench. Extensive experiments on both show that SpaTime outperforms streaming baselines and narrows the gap to offline spatial specialists.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video-language models. Building on image-language pretraining, video LLMs ( Li et al. 2023 ; Maaz et al. 2024 ; Lin et al. 2024 ; Li et al. 2025 ; Zhang et al. 2025d ) extend instruction-tuned dialogue to video. Recent open-source generalists, e.g . , Qwen2.5-VL ( Bai et al. 2025 ) and InternVL-2.5 ( Chen et al. 2024d ) , approach proprietary systems ( OpenAI 2024 ; Google DeepMind 2024 ; Anthropic 2024 ) , while MovieChat ( Song et al. 2024 ) and MA-LMM ( He et al. 2024 ) compress past frames into memory banks for long video. Note, all of these models process a video as a completed clip and, as VSI-Bench ( Yang et al. 2025b ) reports, remain weak at 3D spatial reasoning. We target this challenge under the stricter constraint that frames arrive as a stream.

Spatial reasoning in vision-language models. Existing methods
either ground an LLM in explicit 3D input such as point clouds or reconstructed
scenes ( Hong et al. 2023 ; Chen et al. 2024c ; Huang et al. 2024 ) , or reason from 2D
observations alone without global 3D structure ( Chen et al. 2024a ; Cheng et al. 2024 ; Zhang et al. 2025b ) . Closest to our setting, VSI-Bench ( Yang et al. 2025b ) standardized spatial reasoning in egocentric video, prompting methods that inject geometry into video LLMs. Video-3D LLM ( Zheng et al. 2025b ) adds position-aware encodings, VG-LLM ( Zheng et al. 2025a ) fuses VGGT ( Wang et al. 2025a ) tokens into

VSTI-Bench ( Fan et al. 2026 ) further extends evaluation to camera and object motion. However, all these methods operate offline and require the full video before answering. Unlike these methods, SpaTime brings explicit geometry to the streaming setting.

blocks.en: Streaming VLMs. VideoLLM-online ( Chen et al. 2024b ) introduced the streaming dialogue paradigm, processing frames sequentially and deciding at each step whether to respond. Flash-VStream ( Zhang et al. 2025a ) keeps a compressed memory for long streams, Dispider ( Qian et al. 2025 ) disentangles perception, decision, and reaction, and Streamo ( Xia et al. 2026 ) adds explicit state tokens with a state-aware focal loss for the silent/responsive class imbalance. Effective as these models are at deciding when to respond, they do not maintain an explicit 3D representation. SpaTime retains their frame-by-frame decision-making and incorporates geometry into it.
blocks.zh: 流出 VLM. VideoLLM 在线 (Chen等2024b.)引入了流出式对话范式,按顺序处理帧,并在每一步决定是否响应. Flash-VStream (Zhang等 2025a)为长溪保持压缩内存,Dispider (Qian等 2025)为分解感知,决定和反应,Streto (Xia等 2026)为无声/应答类失衡增加了明显的状态标志,并有状态意识焦点损失. 由于这些模式正在决定何时作出反应,因此它们并不保持明确的三维表述。 SpaTime保留了逐个框架的决策,并将几何学纳入其中.

blocks.en: Online 3D reconstruction and causal geometry encoding. Online 3D reconstruction spans SLAM systems ( Mur-Artal and Tardós 2017 ; Teed and Deng 2021 ; Zhu et al. 2022 ) and, more recently, fast feed-forward pointmap regression. DUSt3R ( Wang et al. 2024 ) and MASt3R ( Leroy et al. 2024 ) recover geometry from image pairs without poses, and Spann3R ( Wang and Agapito 2025 ) , Fast3R ( Yang et al. 2025a ) , and MonST3R ( Zhang et al. 2025c ) extend this incrementally, at scale, and to dynamic scenes. VGGT ( Wang et al. 2025a ) and CUT3R ( Wang et al. 2025b ) predict dense geometry, but rely on global attention over all frames, which makes them inherently offline. MASt3R-SLAM ( Murai et al. 2025 ) and LeanGate ( Xiong et al. 2026 ) target reconstruction and efficiency rather than language-model integration. Most related to this work is StreamVGGT ( Zhuo et al. 2026 ) , which distills VGGT into a causal transformer with a KV cache, yielding geometry tokens at constant per-frame cost with minimal quality loss. SpaTime builds directly on it, feeding causal geometry tokens into a streaming VLM for spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在线3D重建与因果几何编码. 在线3D重建跨越了SLAM系统(Mur-Artal和Tardós 2017;Teed和 Deng 2021;Zhu等 2022),以及更近的快速向上点映回归. DUST3R (Wang等2024年)和MAST3R (Leroy等2024年)从没有姿势的图像对中恢复几何,而Spann3R (Wang和Agapito 2025年),Fast3R (Yang等2025年a),和MONST3R (Zhang等2025年c)则逐渐地,规模地扩展了这一功能并扩展到了动态场景. VGGT (Wang et al. 2025a)和 CUT3R (Wang et al. 2025b) 预测密度几何,但依靠全球对所有帧的关注,这使得它们本质上脱线. MAT3R-SLAM (Murai等人,2025年)和LeanGate (Xiong等人,2026年)的目标是重建和效率,而不是语言-模型融合. 与本作最相關的是StreamVGGT( Zhu等2026年出品),将VGGT分馏为带有KV缓存的因果变压器,以每帧不变成本而产生几何符号并最小质量损失. SpaTime直接以它为基础,将因果几何符号输入流体VLM来进行空间推理.

blocks.en: Concurrent work. Stream3D-VLM ( Yu et al. 2026 ) concurrently develops an online VLM for 3D spatial understanding, likewise building on a frozen StreamVGGT encoder. It fuses geometry through stacked cross-attention and casts response timing as next-token prediction over two decision tokens under a weighted token-level loss. In contrast, SpaTime fuses by additive projection on an exactly aligned token grid, adopts a three-state protocol, and supervises timing with a differentiable response-time loss on the expected response time. Additionally, our introduced benchmarks are streaming conversions of established ones, which keeps accuracy directly comparable with the offline literature.
blocks.zh: 同时工作. 流线3D-VLM (Yu等人,2026年)同时开发了用于3D空间理解的在线VLM,同样基于被冻结的StreamVGGT编码器. 它通过堆放的交叉注意来将几何线融为一体,并将反应时间设定为在加权信使级损失下对两个决策信使的下一个信使的预测。 相形之下,SpaTime引信在完全对齐的标志网格上通过添加剂投射,采用三种状态的协议,并监督在预期反应时间上出现不同反应时间损失的时间。 此外,我们采用的基准是既定基准的流转转换,这与离线文献的准确性保持直接可比性。

blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: We review the background and notation needed to understand this paper, including the streaming task formulation, Streamo ( Xia et al. 2026 ) for streaming video-language modeling (Sec. 3.1 ), and StreamVGGT ( Zhuo et al. 2026 ) for causal geometry encoding (Sec. 3.2 ).

blocks.en: 5 Streaming Spatial Reasoning Benchmarks

blocks.en: Existing spatial benchmarks, e.g . , VSTI-Bench ( Fan et al. 2026 ) and VSI-Bench ( Yang et al. 2025b ) , evaluate full videos offline, so they cannot capture when an answer becomes viable. We therefore convert them into StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench with a geometry-grounded pipeline. We preserve the original questions and ground-truth answers built on ScanNet ( Dai et al. 2017 ) , ScanNet++ ( Yeshwanth et al. 2023 ) , and ARKitScenes ( Baruch et al. 2021 ) , which keeps accuracy directly comparable with the offline literature. As shown in Fig. 3 , the pipeline has four stages: (a) rebuilding the 3D assets and a per-frame visibility index (Sec. 5.1 ); (b) confirming recognizability with a VLM (Sec. 5.2 ); (c) selecting the answer frame t ans t_{\text{ans}} (Sec. 5.3 ); and (d) deriving the streaming variant (Sec. 5.4 ).

blocks.en: 5.1 3D Assets and Geometry-Driven Visibility
blocks.zh: 5.1 三维资产和几何辨识

blocks.en: We first collect 3D asset annotations for each scene. For example, we read per-frame camera poses and intrinsics from the .sens archives in ScanNet. For all datasets, we take object-level oriented bounding boxes (OBBs) from the dataset’s instance annotations. We then map each dataset’s category labels to a unified question vocabulary, so that every referred object can be grounded to a 3D box.
blocks.zh: 我们首先为每个场景收集3D资产说明. 例如,我们从ScanNet的.sens档案中阅读了每帧相机的外观和内在内容。 对所有数据集,我们从数据集实例说明中取取面向对象的边框(OBBs)。 然后,我们将每个数据集的分类标签映射到一个统一的问题词汇,这样每一个被引用的对象都可以被基于一个3D框.

blocks.en: With these assets in place, we build a per-frame visibility index for every object-frame pair. Specifically, we project the eight corners of each object’s OBB into the image plane via the camera pose and intrinsics and take the 2D bounding rectangle of the projection. From it we compute an area ratio , the fraction of the frame covered by the rectangle clipped to the image, and a containment ratio , the fraction of the unclipped rectangle that lies inside the image boundary. Containment rejects a case that a naïve area threshold would accept, i.e . , a camera close to a large object fills the frame yet observes almost none of it. We consider an object visible when (a) its containment ratio exceeds a minimum threshold, or its area ratio is large enough that the object dominates the frame even when partially cut off; (b) its area ratio exceeds a minimum size, rejecting distant specks; (c) its center lies within a maximum distance from the camera; and (d) for ARKitScenes and ScanNet++, it is not occluded by intervening geometry in the sensor depth map. The product of the two ratios serves as a per-frame visibility score for ranking views. We report the thresholds in Appendix Sec. C .
blocks.zh: 随着这些资产到位,我们为每对对象建立了每帧能见度指数. 具体地说,我们通过相机的姿势和内在将每个物体的OBB的八个角投射入图像平面,并取出投影的2D相接矩. 我们从中计算出一个区域比例, 被矩形剪接的框被分到图像, 和被封存的比例, 即位于图像边界内的未被剪接的矩形的分出。 封装拒绝一个天真区域阈值会接受的情况,即接近一个大物体的相机充斥着这个框架,但几乎没有观察到它。 我们认为,当(a) 其封存比超过最低阈值,或其面积比足够大,即使部分断接时也主宰了框架;(b) 其面积比超过最小尺寸,拒绝遥远的光谱;(c) 其中心距离相机最大距离;(d) 对于ARKitScens和ScanNet++,它不会被传感器深度图中的干涉几何所包围。 这两个比率的产物可作为按框架的能见度评分,用于排名。 我们在附录C中报告阈值。

blocks.en: 5.2 VLM Confirmation on Visible Frames
blocks.zh: 5.2 VLM 在可见框架上确认

blocks.en: Geometric visibility guarantees that a box projects into the frame, not that the object is recognizable there, e.g . , motion blur, a doorway edge, or a box that actually sits behind a counter all pass the frustum test. We therefore use a vision-language model to double-check. For each object referenced by a question, we overlay its 3D box as a wireframe on the frames where it is geometrically visible and use Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al. 2025 ) to confirm that the object is recognizable. The check is deliberately conservative, i.e . , parsing is fail-open ; only a reply that is an explicit “no” overrides geometry, and an object is never rejected for all its frames. This removes early false-positive views without dropping any question.
blocks.zh: 几何能见度可以保证一个盒子投入帧中,而不是物体在那里被识别,例如,运动模糊,门道边缘,或者一个实际坐在柜台后方的盒子都通过了frustum测试. 因此,我们使用一种视觉语言模式进行双重检查。 对于每个被一个问题所引用的物体,我们将它的3D盒作为线框覆盖在它几何可见的帧上,并使用Quen2.5-VL-7B(Bai等2025)确认该物体是可辨认的. 检查是故意保守的, 即解析是失败打开的 ; 只有一个回答是明确的“ 不” 覆盖几何, 一个对象永远不会被拒绝 。 这删除了早期的虚假正面观点,而不放弃任何疑问.

For instance, an object counting question sets t ans t_{\text{ans}} to the first frame in which all instances of the queried object become visible, since only then can the model produce the correct count. A relational question sets t ans t_{\text{ans}} to the earliest frame at which all involved objects have appeared. The remaining per-type rules follow similar logic and are listed in Appendix Sec. C .

Among streaming models, SpaTime achieves the highest spatial accuracy under both modes, beating the strongest streaming baseline by 4.8 points (strict) and 0.8 (charitable) on average. blocks.en:
The experiment also reveals a clear shortcoming: SpaTime scores 0.0 0.0 on room-size and 3.5 3.5 on object-size estimation. Both categories require predicting an absolute metric extent, yet their question templates are absent from the camera- and object-relational splits of StreamVSTI-Bench used for training, so the model
never encounters their answer form during training. Other streaming baselines exhibit the same failure on these categories, confirming that the cause is insufficient training coverage rather than a fundamental geometric limitation. Because our pipeline can synthesize size-estimation questions automatically, augmenting the training mixture with such samples is a promising direction for future work.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We propose SpaTime, a streaming VLM that brings explicit 3D geometry into causal video reasoning. SpaTime fuses causal geometry tokens from a frozen StreamVGGT encoder into a streaming LLM at every frame, and a response-time loss supervises when the model answers. To train and evaluate in this setting, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming versions of established spatial QA benchmarks. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and cuts the mean response-time error from 0.35 s to 0.12 s relative to the strongest streaming baseline. We hope SpaTime and these two benchmarks encourage future work on VLMs that reason about 3D space and respond promptly as video frames continue to arrive.
blocks.zh: 我们提出SpaTime,一种流动的VLM,它将清晰的3D几何带入了因果视频推理. SpaTime从一个被冻结的StreamVGGT编码器将因果几何符号装入每个帧的流出LLM中,模型解答时一个响应-时间损失监督. 为了在这种环境下进行训练和评估,我们构建了StreamVSTI-Bench和StreamVSI-Bench,这是既定空间质量评估基准的流出版本。 在StreatVSTI-Bench上,SpaTime达到49.2%的总精度,相对于最强的流线基线,将平均响应时间误差从0.35 s被削减到0.12 s. 我们希望SpaTime和这两个基准能够鼓励未来关于三维空间的VLM的工作,并在视频帧不断到来时迅速作出反应。

blocks.en: Visibility index. An object-frame pair is accepted when the box’s containment is at least 0.2 0.2 or its area ratio at least 0.05 0.05 , its area ratio exceeds 0.002 0.002 , and its center depth is within 8 8 m. blocks.en: Where the timing difficulty lives. Tab. A3 breaks the StreamVSTI-Bench results down by temporal channel. Current and past questions are answerable on the asking round by construction, and the model behaves accordingly where it emits ⟨ Response ⟩ \langle\texttt{Response}\rangle on exactly the ground-truth round in 98.7 98.7 – 100 % 100\% of these samples. Essentially all timing difficulty is therefore concentrated in the future channel, where the model must decide how long to wait; even there it hits the exact ground-truth round 60.4 % 60.4\% (multiple-choice) to 74.3 % 74.3\% (numerical) of the time, and when it misses the round it gets early rather than late (mean signed error − 0.37 -0.37 and − 0.24 -0.24 rounds).
